featuredReason: 虽然该新闻主要针对大田作物施肥场景，但其中体现的精准变量施肥、高速作业与智能监控技术（如雷达监测撒播图案、自动流量控制）对智慧畜牧行业中的饲草料种植及牧场精准管理具有参考价值，可启发养殖场在自有饲料地或粪肥还田环节引入类似自动化、数据化设备。
contentFull:
Rauch shows latest top-of-the-range fertiliser spreader at DLG Feldtage

 23-06 | Crop solutions | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

After the Axis 25 introduced last year, spreader manufacturer Rauch is now launching the new Axis 55. The model replaces the current 50.2 models and mainly offers more capacity than its predecessor. This model has a 3,500-litre hopper. Photos: René Koerhuis

The DLG Feldtage did not feature many machine premieres, but fertiliser spreader manufacturer Rauch did use the event to show a new machine.

And with the Axis 55, that is immediately the top model after the manufacturer launched the new Axis 25 last year. The Axis 55 succeeds the existing Axis 50.2 models and will therefore also be available in a mechanically PTO-driven version and a hydraulically driven version. The similarity with its ‘little brother’, the Axis 25, is the increased maximum flow rate of 675 kg/min. That is 30% more than before.

 Rauch further developed the discs and vanes for a wider range of working widths. The intention is that 3 disc sets will allow spreading from 12 to 56 metres wide, although it cannot be ruled out that a 4th set will be needed for light fertiliser types at large working widths.Up to 900 kg/ha

The new Rauch top model fits in with developments and the drive for more capacity, with hopper volume and especially flow rate increasing in order to spread at relatively high forward speeds. Thanks to the increased flow rate, it should be possible to apply 900 kg/ha at a working width of 36 metres while driving at 25 km/h. At the other end of the spectrum, low application rates, such as slug pellets for example, can be applied without modifications and/or accessories.

3 disc sets, up to 56 metres

Depending on the fertiliser type, the spreader can spread at a minimum width of 12 metres and a maximum width of 56 metres. For this, ‘only’ 3 different disc sets are required. Until now, 6 disc sets were needed to cover those working widths. The shape of the discs and vanes has been further developed with a view to more working widths, previously 18-50 metres, and as before the vanes are coated for a longer service life.

 The border spreading plate is also new and is now called GSE-X. With this, in bed cultivation you can also prevent fertiliser from ending up in the wheel track.The optional Axmat system with radar sensors for monitoring the spreading pattern and the GSE border spreading plate have also been renewed and are now called Axmat-X and GSE-X respectively. With the latter, in bed cultivation you can also prevent fertiliser from ending up in the wheel track.

The Axis 55 has a maximum payload of 5,500 kilograms and the manufacturer stresses that you can carry up to 6,500 litres of fertiliser with a relatively low bulk density when choosing the largest hopper volume. The familiar EMC system automatically monitors the flow and therefore the application rate. For insight into the current hopper contents, Rauch supplies a weighing frame as before.

A limited pre-series will be available for spring 2027. Series production and pricing will follow later that year.

translationZh:
DLG田间日上并未出现许多机器首发，但撒肥机制造商劳赫确实利用该活动展示了一款新机器。

而Axis 55，在制造商去年推出新款Axis 25之后，立即成为顶级型号。Axis 55接替现有的Axis 50.2系列，因此也将提供机械式PTO驱动版本和液压驱动版本。与其“小兄弟”Axis 25的相似之处在于最大流量提升至675公斤/分钟，比之前增加了30%。

劳赫进一步开发了圆盘和叶片，以覆盖更宽的工作宽度范围。其意图是，3套圆盘组即可实现12至56米宽的撒播，尽管不能排除对于轻质肥料类型在较大工作宽度下需要第4套圆盘组。

**高达900公斤/公顷**

这款新的劳赫顶级型号顺应了提高产能的发展趋势，料斗容积尤其是流量增加，以便以相对较高的前进速度进行撒播。得益于增加的流量，在36米工作宽度、25公里/小时行驶速度下，应能施撒900公斤/公顷。在另一端的低施用量场景，例如施撒杀螺剂，无需改装或附件即可进行。

**3套圆盘组，可达56米**

根据肥料类型，撒肥机可撒播的最小宽度为12米，最大宽度为56米。为此“仅”需3套不同的圆盘组。此前，覆盖这些工作宽度需要6套圆盘组。圆盘和叶片的形状经过进一步开发，以覆盖更多工作宽度（此前为18-50米），并且叶片仍带有涂层以延长使用寿命。

边界撒播板也是新的，现在称为GSE-X。使用它，在垄作栽培中还可以防止肥料落入轮辙。

用于监控撒播图案的Axmat系统（带雷达传感器）以及GSE边界撒播板也已更新，现在分别称为Axmat-X和GSE-X。使用后者，在垄作栽培中可以防止肥料落入轮辙。

Axis 55的最大有效载荷为5500公斤，制造商强调，选择最大料斗容积时，可承载多达6500升低容重肥料。熟悉的EMC系统自动监控流量，从而监控施用量。为了解当前料斗内容物，劳赫仍像以前一样提供称重框架。

限量预产将于2027年春季上市。批量生产和定价将在同年晚些时候进行。
